name: Cinnamon Roll Cappuccino
flavor_notes: A decadently creamy cappuccino with a base of condensed milk and vanilla, topped with cinnamon sugar.
barista_note: Warm the mug first so the milk and coffee stay hot to the last sip.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: In your serving mug, combine 1.5 tbsp Sweetened Condensed Milk and 0.125 tsp Vanilla Extract.
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it into the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until fully dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
Finish with a dusting of Cinnamon Sugar.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
steps: Combine sweetened condensed milk and vanilla extract in your serving cup and stir well.
Heat and froth the milk until it reaches latte consistency, then pour it into the cup.
Brew the coffee capsule directly into the cup with the other ingredients.
Stir gently to combine. Finish by sprinkling cinnamon sugar on top.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic
steps: In your serving mug, combine 1.5 tbsp Sweetened Condensed Milk and 0.125 tsp Vanilla Extract.
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 2 oz (60 ml) hot water directly in the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
Finish with a dusting of Cinnamon Sugar.
